dependencies.reviewViewer: /production-assets/rig-lab/node_modules/three/... is referenced but rig-lab currently has no package manifest. Recreate exact three 0.186.1 dependency at this path or update only portable-copy viewer module paths.
dependencies.mobile: Node22+, Capacitor8.5.3, AndroidSDK36/JDK21, supported Xcode/iOS16+. Run npm ci, npm run build:bridge, npx cap sync to restore excluded native public copies. Current mobile remains web0.26.0-based 1.0.0.

limitations: This inventory does not authorize transferring signing credentials, browser profiles, Meshy keys or account secrets.
Saved player progress lives in browser localStorage and does not move with source or git.
Raw evidence sourceDirectory fields are absolute in original report; resolving them unchanged can falsely pass relocated tests against the old computer.
All v0.28.0 old assets are intentionally required by preserved-byte regressions; omit only by consciously redesigning these tests, not by assuming metadata-only coverage.
Some authoring tools contain legacy target paths and produce assets; do not run them blindly after transfer.
